chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa'd bin Abdullah, from Ya'qoub bin Yazid, from Yahya bin Mubarak, from Abdullah bin Jabala, from a man, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: "And He made me blessed wherever I am". He said: Beneficial.
And He made me blessed wherever I am

key_terms.أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُ: Wherever I was; indicating ubiquity or presence in all places
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Exalted and Glorious; an honorific title for Allah
key_terms.مُبَارَكًا: Blessed; a state of being endowed with divine favor and goodness
key_terms.نَافِعًا: Beneficial; bringing benefit, utility, or advantage to others

ai.seo_question: What does the word 'mubarak' mean in the verse 'And He made me blessed wherever I am'?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) interprets the term 'mubarak' in Surah Maryam as 'nafi'an' (beneficial), emphasizing that the Prophet's blessing is manifested through his tangible utility and positive impact on humanity. This linguistic clarification shifts the focus from a static state of grace to an active, functional role, aligning with the Shia understanding of prophetic leadership as a source of continuous benefit for the community.
